newsitem.title: USA: Frisch's sets 1 million share self tender.
newsitem.headline: Frisch's sets 1 million share self tender.

text.p: Frisch's Restaurants Inc said Monday that its board has authorized a modified Dutch auction" self tender offer to purchase up to one million shares of its common stock.
It said the offer will begin on July 14 and expire on August 8. Terms include a purchase price of not greater than $17 per share nor less than $15, net to seller in cash.
Frisch's said that in a modified Dutch auction, the company sets a price range and shareholders are given an opportunity to specify prices within that range at which they are willing to sell shares.
The company said the tender offer is not conditioned on any number of shares being tendered.
Frisch's said the board believes that share repurchases funded by borrowings under its credit facility will enhance value and provide a liquidity opportunity to shareholders.
Furman Selz is serving as dealer manager for the tender offer.
